# Outreach draft: check the separator before you decide about the framework

**Use:** one-to-one, or as a cover letter attached to a submission through the public venues in `03_public_contact_points.csv`. **Not** for bulk send.

**Hard precondition:** this is a methods claim in `general` and `specified` mode, not a measurement. Do not edit it into a claim about which cognitive features are universal. The feature list is a declared `gap`.

---

**Subject:** One method question: what would change your mind about a universal-vs-learned call?

> Hi [name],
>
> I am working on a narrow methods question in cross-cultural cognitive science and would value a check from someone who actually runs these comparisons. I am not asking you to read a theory first, and I am not asking you to agree with anything. If the separator does not survive, there is nothing else to look at.
>
> **The residual, in effect terms.** For a cognitive pattern, a population and an observed form, we want to say which of several candidate sources produced the reading: shared machinery, exposure-dependent learning, a documented transmission history, or an institution-fixed convention. The difficulty is that all four can produce the same behavioral reading. Counting more studies in more populations does not separate them, because the studies share an evidence pool. What is owed is a way to discriminate among sources, not more of the same observation.
>
> **The separator I would like checked (`general` shape, `specified` per method, not `grounded`):**
> 1. Split the question rather than pooling it. Universal and learned overlap: a form can be universal in machinery and learned in its triggering conditions. A single percentage hides the signal.
> 2. Ask which substructure is invariant and which member or bond varies, not "which bin does this feature go in." The invariant item is a functional group; the variation is a binding.
> 3. Discriminate among sources using low-overlap frames: cross-species presence, developmental exposure, documented transmission lineage, and an intervention or instrument that changes the candidate cause. Convergent derivation from independent frames is evidence; an adopted form with a provenance record is diffusion. The contents look identical, so only the record separates them.
> 4. Require a non-updating anchor and state a refusal before running. A measurement whose value shifts when the researchers reinterpret it is not an anchor, and a method that cannot refuse a universal claim can only accumulate them.
>
> **What I am not claiming:** that any particular cognitive feature is universal; that the separator returns a feature list; that cross-cultural psychology has been wrong about any specific result; or that this is settled by experiment. It returns a shape and a set of instruments. The figures cannot name a feature, and this derivation cannot name one either.
>
> **What would refute the separator, written before this message:**
> 1. A clean partition, with no pattern showing both invariant machinery and variable binding.
> 2. A cultural variation that introduces a new cognitive primitive rather than a new member or bond of a shared kind.
> 3. Per-slot source assignments that coincide with a pooled assignment on every pattern tested, so the slot discipline changes nothing.
> 4. Two candidate source classes shown to be always distinguishable at the behavioral reading without provenance or a source-discriminating instrument.
> 5. An alleged anchor whose reported value moves when frames push on it, or two "independent" frames shown to draw on one dataset.
>
> I wrote these down before sending this. If any holds, I retract the separator. A one-line "this fails because..." is more useful to me than agreement. If you would rather not engage, no reply is needed.
>
> **If it survives, and only then:** the sources are below. The figures are the authority, not my summary of them.
> - Canonical figures and formula (public repo, branch `general-agent`): https://github.com/IsaiahN/tether/tree/general-agent/figures
> - Figures README, canonical usage rule: https://github.com/IsaiahN/tether/blob/general-agent/figures/README.md
> - The Hard Problem is About Source, on instruments that cannot comment on their source: https://adventuresinml.substack.com/p/the-hard-problem-is-about-source
>
> **If you want to use the machinery:** the formula is in the figures link. Run it on a comparison you know well and can check against a ground. Write down what would refute your result *before* you run it, and label the mode of what you get. A reported failure is more useful to me than a reported success.
>
> Best,
> [name]

---

## Why this version is ordered this way

| the move | figure-grounded reason |
|---|---|
| Residual and refuter first, theory second | Fig 10 :52, "Bring a characterised residual, never the source." Fig 2 :45, "Frames range against the ground. They do not negotiate with it." |
| No request for agreement | Fig 2 :35, "Alignment is triangulation, not negotiation. A mirror cannot correct you." |
| Pre-registered refuter | A falsifier written before the run is a design instrument, not only an honesty device. |
| Mode stated on every claim | `THE_FORMULA.md`, "Mode. general · specified · grounded. State which." |
| Feature list withheld | Fig 13 :135, "It cannot say which primitive is missing, because naming it would mean already holding it." |
| Source discrimination before replication | Fig 8 :51, "Convergent derivation and adopted import look identical in the contents. Only the record of where each came from separates them"; Hard Problem essay, "the instrument is speaking only about what it measured, it cannot comment on the source." |
| Split rather than pool | Fig 9 :54, "And when the split lands on a union rather than a partition, unbundle before you search again." |
| Independence bought, not assumed | Fig 2 :31, "Two people reading the same report are not two frames; two instruments pointed at the same thing are." |
| No prestige ask, no "trust" | *The Recursive Self-Improvement Trap*: "Prestige can fund an action. It can give an action a budget to be tried. But it cannot settle an action. Only the ground can settle it." |
| Offer the formula as a method to reuse | Fig 4 :22, "Only methods cross up. Only head starts come down." |
| Ask recipients to state their own ground and refuter | `THE_FORMULA.md` "Direction": a frame cannot check the direction of its own question. |

## Two-stage offer, explicitly

1. **Stage 1:** send the residual, the separator shape and the five refuters above. Ask what the recipient would count as a failure. Record their verdict before showing any theory.
2. **Stage 2, opt-in only:** if they are curious, send the three links, with the note that the figures, not this summary, are the authority.
3. **Stage 3:** offer the formula as a reusable method, with the instruction that each user writes their own refuter and states their own mode.

Stage 2 is opt-in by construction. Once a recipient has absorbed the framework, their agreement stops being evidence (Fig 2 :40: "agreement about the world is worthless when the agreeing frames share an evidence pool"). Their stage-1 verdict is never pooled as corroboration.
